Brief review 2026-09-30 (Indoor slippers creative hub) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. Typo in the headline and primary text: `Nerör källartrappan glider gamla tofflor av.` must be `Nerför källartrappan glider gamla tofflor av.` If the static is already rendered, it carries the typo — render it again with the corrected line.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.
